bikeman-05

BikeMan has been providing bikeability training in and around Inverness since 2019.
Fully qualified as a Ride Leader and a Cycling Instructor for Children and for Adults.
PVG registered with Highland Council, High Life Highland, and Cycling UK.
Bikeability in Highland schools is delivered by the Highland Council.
Bikeman supports this by providing Learn to Ride in Inverness schools.
Regardless of age or ability, the goal is to learn how to ride a bike.
On completion, children will be well-prepared and ready for bikeability.
The course of Learn to Ride sessions is customised for each individual.
email: bikeman.uk@tuta.io
